product.name: Visual-Diagram Parsing
product.description: Parses visual diagrams into code to reproduce diagrams and provide APIs for AI agents, enabling text-based querying of diagrams and drawings.

product.name: Agentic Enterprise Search
product.description: An enterprise search system using chain-of-memory reasoning and KV cache management to retrieve and reason over complex documents more accurately and efficiently than vector RAG.

product.name: Chain-of-Memory Retrieval Technique
product.description: A retrieval method that decomposes question answering into planning, retrieval, and reasoning steps to improve accuracy and efficiency over long documents.
